Induction does NOT make your stove top cool enough to touch. If you have been heating a pan for a reasonable amount of time 10 minutes or more, the pan will actually heat the top making it too hot to touch. Its only cool enough to touch if you run it for a ridiculously short amount of time, or on a very low setting
